title: 第三章 最恶马元三霄仙子第四章 多宝讲道吞食仙杏
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
“额，可我只是记名弟子，按照规矩，不可入碧游宫内听道。”
李玄霄想起了之前自己一人前来时候，被拦在宫外的事情。
但石矶微微摇头道：“我截教何时有这等规矩了！宫内、宫外，看的不是身份，是实力。你师姐我虽实力不算太强，可终究也是真仙巅峰，太靠前的位置是不行，但带着你随我同入碧游宫中听道，其他人不会说什么。”
顿了下，石矶笑道：“若是今日运气好，云霄师姐她们也来，或许还能带我们坐在最前。”
“这般，便多谢师姐了！”
“你与我这般客气作甚，真要计较，怕是你谢不过来了！”
石矶带着李玄霄一路向前。
李玄霄跟在石矶身侧，心中不由感激。
只是想着自己此番虽能坐得更近听道，但自己只是区区记名弟子，该如何才能和多宝大师兄说上话，求他为自己压制仙杏狂暴风雷之力。
正思忖间，前方云道上忽然传来一阵喧哗。
李玄霄抬眼望去，只见数十名外门弟子正三三两两地结伴而行，其中几个灰袍弟子簇拥着一人，那人身形魁梧，面容凶恶，大摇大摆地走在云道正中，颇为嚣张。
石矶见此眉头紧皱，眼中满是怒气：“那为首的便是马元！此前他与我同为真仙巅峰，这才多久竟迈入玄仙境界了，定是吞食了那枚十万年朱果！”
李玄霄眸光微动，定睛看去，这马元长得也的确是凶抽万分，面如瓜皮，发似朱砂，獠牙巨口，身穿大红袍，颈上挂一串人顶骨念珠，胸前悬一金镶瓢，乃人半个脑袋所制。
且其眼、耳、鼻中还不时冒出火来，如顽蛇吐信。
这倒是让李玄霄更坚定了不可轻易食用那风雷双杏的想法。
“如今他势大，先避一避吧！”
说着，石矶倒是压制了心中怒意主动对李玄霄开口说道。
洪荒之上，实力为尊。
李玄霄没有多言，点点头，现在自己实力不够，没必要多生事端，便与石矶往云道一侧行去。
但李玄霄心中暗道，石矶师姐不仅对自己有救命之恩，平日里也多有照顾，这马元敢夺石矶师姐机缘，日后自当有一番计较！

然而树欲静而风不止。
“这不是石矶师妹吗？”
一道阴阳怪气的声音响起，马元已然看见了他们，并大步流星地走了过来。
“师妹怎走的这般快！若不是师妹相助，我怎能得了那十万年朱果，先师妹一步迈入玄仙境界？”
说着，他目光又在李玄霄身上一扫，咧嘴笑道：“这位是新来的师弟？面生得很啊？我怎不记得我截教外门还有你这般的人物？”
石矶面色当即冷了下来：“马元，这里是碧游宫，今日更是多宝大师兄讲道的日子，你莫要在这里徒生事端！”
“呵呵，看石矶师妹这话说的，我马元是那种惹事的人吗？”
马元皮笑肉不笑，目光转向李玄霄：“只是看这位师弟面善，想认识认识。师弟，叫什么名字？入门几年了？”
李玄霄抬眸看他，神色平静：“李玄霄，截教记名弟子，入门百余年。”
“哦？记名弟子啊。”
马元回头与身后几个师弟对视一眼，皆是露出戏谑的笑，“那师弟你可知，在我截教，记名弟子想要听道，得在碧游宫外？”
说着，他往前逼近一步，身上隐隐散发出一股令人不适的阴冷气息。
“你如今怎么到了我外门弟子听道之地？还不赶紧出去！”
石矶一步上前挡在李玄霄身前：“马元！此前夺我机缘之事，我不与你深究，今日乃多宝大师兄讲道之日，我劝你不要惹是生非！”
“石矶，你与我同为外门弟子，也敢拿多宝师兄压我？更何况，我眼下已是玄仙境界！而你，不过还只是区区真仙！我告诉你，今儿个也是师兄我心情好，不想跟你计较。但他……”
他看向李玄霄：“你还是恭恭敬敬叫我一声马师兄，然后退出碧游宫，去宫外听道方是上选。”
李玄霄眸光一凝。
本想着今日前来听多宝大师兄讲道，却不想在此处遇上这等麻烦。
content_en:
"Uh, but I'm just a registered disciple. According to the rules, I'm not allowed to enter Biyou Palace to listen to the sermon."
Li Xuanxiao remembered how he was stopped outside the palace when he came alone.
But Shi Ji shook his head slightly and said: "Since when did my teachings have such rules? What matters inside and outside the palace is not status, but strength. Although your senior sister and I are not too strong, I am still at the peak of the True Immortal, and a position that is too forward will not work. But if I take you with me to listen to the teachings in Biyou Palace, others will not say anything."
After a pause, Shi Ji smiled and said: "If we are lucky today and Senior Sister Yunxiao and the others come too, they may be able to take us to sit at the front."
"In that case, thank you very much, Senior Sister!"
"Why are you being so polite to me? If you really care about it, I'm afraid you won't be able to thank me!"
Shi Ji led Li Xuanxiao forward.
Li Xuanxiao followed Shi Ji, feeling grateful in his heart.
I just thought that although I could sit closer and listen to the sermon this time, I was only a registered disciple. How could I talk to Senior Brother Duobao and ask him to suppress the violent wind and thunder power of Xianxing for me.
While I was thinking about it, there was a sudden noise on the cloud road ahead.
Li Xuanxiao raised his eyes and saw dozens of outer sect disciples walking together in twos and threes. Among them, several gray-robed disciples were surrounding one person. The man was tall and burly, with a ferocious face. He was walking arrogantly in the middle of the cloud road.
Seeing this, Shi Ji frowned, and his eyes were full of anger: "The leader is Ma Yuan! He and I were both at the peak of True Immortal before, but now he has entered the realm of Xuan Immortal. He must have swallowed that hundred thousand year red fruit!"
Li Xuanxiao's eyes moved slightly and he looked intently. He saw that Ma Yuan was indeed extremely fierce-looking, with a face like melon skin, hair like cinnabar, and a huge mouth with fangs. He was wearing a big red robe, with a string of human parietal bone rosary hanging around his neck, and a gold inlaid gourd hanging on his chest, which was made from half a human head.
And fire would come out of his eyes, ears, and nose from time to time, like a stubborn snake spitting out messages.
This actually made Li Xuanxiao more determined not to eat the wind and thunder apricots easily.
"Now that he is powerful, let's avoid him first!"
With that said, Shi Ji suppressed the anger in his heart and took the initiative to speak to Li Xuanxiao.
Above the ancient world, strength is respected.
Li Xuanxiao didn't say much and nodded. Now that he was not strong enough, there was no need to cause trouble, so he and Shi Ji walked to the side of Yundao.
But Li Xuanxiao secretly thought in his heart that Senior Sister Shiji not only saved his life, but also took care of him in daily life. If Ma Yuan dared to take away Senior Sister Shiji's opportunity, he would have to worry about it in the future!
However, the tree wants to be still but the wind does not stop.
"Isn't this Junior Sister Shiji?"
A strange voice sounded, Ma Yuan had already seen them, and strode over.
"How could Junior Sister move so fast! If it weren't for Junior Sister's help, how could I have obtained the hundred thousand year red fruit and entered the Xuanxian realm before Junior Sister?"
As he said that, he glanced at Li Xuanxiao again and grinned: "Is this the new junior brother? He looks very handsome? Why don't I remember that there is someone like you in my outer sect?"
Shi Ji's face immediately turned cold: "Ma Yuan, this is Biyou Palace, and today is the day when Senior Brother Duobao is giving a lecture. Don't cause trouble here!"
"Haha, judging from what Junior Sister Shi Ji said, am I, Ma Yuan, the kind of person who causes trouble?"
Ma Yuanpi smiled but turned to Li Xuanxiao: "I just want to get to know this junior brother because he looks kind. Junior brother, what's your name? How many years have you been in the profession?"
Li Xuanxiao raised his eyes and looked at him with a calm expression: "Li Xuanxiao, a registered disciple of Jiejiao, has been a disciple for more than a hundred years."
"Oh? A registered disciple."
Ma Yuan turned around and looked at each other with the junior disciples behind him, and they all showed joking smiles, "Junior brother, do you know that when I teach, registered disciples who want to listen to the teachings have to be outside Biyou Palace?"
As he spoke, he took a step closer, and there was a faint, uncomfortable cold aura coming from his body.
"How come you are now at the place where my outer disciples are listening? Why don't you hurry?Get out tight! "
Shi Ji stepped forward and stood in front of Li Xuanxiao: "Ma Yuan! I won’t go into details with you about the things that robbed me of my opportunity before. Today is the day when Senior Brother Duobao is giving a sermon. I advise you not to cause trouble! "
"Shi Ji, you and I are both outer disciples, and you dare to use Senior Brother Duobao to oppress me? What's more, I am now in the realm of Xuanxian! And you are still just a true immortal! Let me tell you, I am a senior brother and I am in a good mood today and I don’t want to argue with you. But he..."
He looked at Li Xuanxiao: "You should respectfully call me Senior Brother Ma, then exit Biyou Palace and go outside the palace to listen to the sermon. Only then will you be chosen. "
Li Xuanxiao's eyes narrowed.
I wanted to come here today to listen to Senior Brother Duobao's sermon, but I didn't want to run into such trouble here.
